text: I have recently wished that I would not wake up tomorrow.
I keep thinking that my life should end.
I have been wondering whether I want to stay alive.
I have recently wished that I could sleep better tomorrow.
I keep thinking that this difficult week should end.
I have been wondering whether I should ask for support.
I cannot imagine any good opportunities in my future.
It feels as if nothing in my situation can change.
